sample_unit: simulated inferences (nine simulated clinical scenarios, patient groups of 50 to 1,000 subjects)
unlisted_practices: Blockchain-anchored tamper-evident audit trail of AI processing, access events, and provenance
Programmable, ledger-enforced patient consent policies for AI use of imaging data
Deterministic reconstruction of AI-assisted clinical decisions via cryptographic processing manifests
Decentralized computation for AI training on de-identified or synthetic data

screen.reason: The paper introduces and empirically tests a blockchain-based decentralized governance and auditability framework overlaid on clinical imaging AI across simulated clinical scenarios to measure governance quality, overhead, and compliance.

primary.practice: blockchain-based audit trails, provenance tracking, and consent enforcement overlay
